key_facts: Project: ImmersionSRS — a YouTube-based language immersion tool with AI explanations
Architecture: pnpm monorepo with apps/backend (NestJS+SQLite) and apps/frontend (React+Vite+TanStack Router)
Backend runs on port 3000, frontend dev on port 5173/5174, CORS enabled for both
AI providers: Groq (primary, qwen/qwen3.6-27b via proxy 127.0.0.1:10809) + OpenCode Zen (fallback, big-pickle model)
OpenCode integration: Backend calls https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/chat/completions as fallback AI provider
OpenCode integration: env var OPENCODE_ZEN_MODEL configures fallback model (default: big-pickle)
Database: better-sqlite3 with Drizzle ORM, two tables: user_settings and flashcards
Subtitles: youtube-transcript library with proxy support and language fallback chains
Flashcards: Full CRUD with word, explanation, sourceSentence, videoId fields
Settings: nativeLanguage, learnedLanguage, numExamples, explanationLevel persisted in SQLite
Recent work: flashcards feature implemented (backend + frontend), uncommitted in git status
opencode.json at /home/allen/.config/opencode/ configures the AI agent system used to develop this project
Containerfile at /home/allen/.config/opencode/Containerfile defines Fedora 44 podman-based dev env
No Dockerfile or docker-compose in the project itself — only the opencode Containerfile exists
call_chains: Frontend fetch -> backend/api/subtitles -> SubtitlesService -> YoutubeTranscript.fetchTranscript (with proxyFetch)
Frontend fetch -> backend/api/ai/explain -> AiService -> FallbackChain -> GroqProvider.proxyFetch -> OpenCodeZenProvider.proxyFetch
Frontend fetch -> backend/api/settings -> SettingsService -> Drizzle SQLite
Frontend fetch -> backend/api/flashcards -> FlashcardsService -> Drizzle SQLite
blast_radius: apps/backend/src/ai/ai-provider.ts — core AI integration with OpenCode Zen API
apps/backend/src/ai/ai.service.ts — AI service orchestration and fallback chain
apps/backend/src/proxy-fetch.ts — HTTP proxy wrapper for external API calls
apps/frontend/src/lib/ai-api.ts — frontend AI API client (hardcoded localhost:3000)

data.for_supervisor: VERDICT: ✅ Complete codebase exploration done. ImmersionSRS is a language learning tool that plays YouTube videos with synchronized subtitles, lets users click words for AI vocabulary/grammar explanations (in Spanish by default), and save flashcards. The opencode integration is specifically: (1) OpenCode Zen API as fallback AI provider at opencode.ai/zen/v1/chat/completions, (2) opencode.json in ~/.config/opencode/ configures the AI agent system used for development, (3) Containerfile provides a reproducible podman-based dev environment. No Dockerfile/docker-compose exists in the project itself. The fallbacks.json shows Groq has failed 10 times, OpenCode Zen 0 times — suggesting Groq is the primary but has reliability issues.
